scope: Test-only route and hold envelope per GPU split, recorded at the per-split axis tables (8 Nov 2026: baselines are raw engine defaults, explicit --placement pins the split) and re-recorded at stage 2 (category=code depth 7, focus=decode arm 1, TP4_PRO decode rows 6, clamped bounds). Each row stage 2 changed keeps its stage-1 values and names its basis: a route arm below or unmeasured (stage 2's GPU confirmation set covers them). The TP splits' concurrency=balanced repeats the single set until stage 3, so TP4_PRO's balanced rows take their single rows' bases (stage 2 changes no TP4_EXL3 row). The recipes yield their draft knobs (and TP4_PRO's rows) to the stage-2 sets, so each recipe row no stage-2 set reaches is the recipe as measured. A later route-family or schedule change needs recorded native comparison; modifiers also need route-local evidence. Re-recorded at stage 3 (each split's base recipe over the raw defaults; the owner's concurrency=balanced rule; the TP4_EXL3 exact-shaping set): each row stage 3 changed keeps its stage-2 values under stage2 and names stage3_basis (q4_on, r7c_g3, same_parsed_configuration, or unmeasured: per-split request 5). Relabelled (stage 3 review D1): same_parsed_configuration is only TP4_EXL3's single rows, whose serve at the default 1M context fits one session and so takes --session_slots=1's defaults, the stage-2 row's parse (U6 arm A5); TP4_PRO's single rows serve the most sessions that fit (two at 1M) where stage 2 served one, so they are unmeasured (U6). Re-recorded for unbounded sessions (9 Nov: context is the user's choice, default 1M, and serve takes as many sessions as fit; no axis set pins --context_tokens or --session_slots): each row this changed keeps its stage-3 values under stage3 and names unbounded_basis unbounded_defaults (unmeasured until U6). The raw defaults themselves (U5a: 1M context on both commands, serve --session_slots=max) change the geometry of every row that pins neither, without changing its route signature; U6 measures them.
